verdict.rationale: The public start-business page links print-and-mail PDF forms for Profit and Non-Profit Articles of Incorporation. The probe confirms the dos.fl.gov guidance pages are openly reachable, so the forms are downloadable without an account. Missing for 10: no evidence of downloadable filing instructions accompanying the forms, no evidence of a print/PDF version of the LLC Articles of Organization or other entity forms, no explicit no-account statement, and no independent hands-on confirmation of the PDF downloads.
